verdict.rationale: Poke is documented as an assistant that lives in messaging channels (Apple Messages, Telegram, WhatsApp, RCS). The pack contains no evidence of an official desktop app, OS-level shortcuts, or screen access. The only related item is a right-click "Send to Poke" example on the API page, which describes an API-based automation rather than a first-party desktop app, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen
